etl_logic: LOOKUP cdr_dt_dim ON cdr_dt_dim.cdr_dt = securities_trade.trade_dt AND securities_trade.trade_dt = :etl_date AND securities_trade.market_id_code IN ('STO','STX','UPX')

description: Mã chứng khoán [SỬA 2026-10-14 — issue QA, O_PTTT_49] Mã CK chuẩn của security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol, nối từ securities_trade theo A17 (HOSE = symbol, HNX = isin_code vì securities_trade.security_symbol_code của HNX là ISSUE_CODE/ISIN); LEFT JOIN + COALESCE để không rơi giao dịch không có trong snapshot.
etl_logic: COALESCE(sts.symbol, securities_trade.security_symbol_code) FROM securities_trade LEFT JOIN (SELECT security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol, security_trading_snapshot.isin_code, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt ORDER BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_time DESC, security_trading_snapshot.sequence DESC) AS rn FROM security_trading_snapshot WHERE security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt = :etl_date) sts ON sts.rn = 1 AND sts.trading_dt = securities_trade.trade_dt AND ((securities_trade.src_stm_code = 'ORDERTRADE_TRADE_BOOK_HOSE' AND sts.symbol = securities_trade.security_symbol_code) OR (securities_trade.src_stm_code = 'ORDERTRADE_TRADE_BOOK_HNX' AND sts.isin_code = securities_trade.security_symbol_code)) WHERE securities_trade.trade_dt = :etl_date AND securities_trade.market_id_code IN ('STO','STX','UPX') [A17: HOSE nối symbol, HNX nối isin_code; LEFT JOIN + COALESCE giữ giao dịch không khớp mã]

description: GTGD khớp theo mã CK × nhóm quy mô lệnh × ngày [SỬA 2026-10-14 — issue QA, O_PTTT_49] Σ GTGD của TỪNG giao dịch khớp (securities_trade.execution_val; HNX ETL derive = execution_price × execution_vol) thuộc band; thay cho GTGD cả ngày của mã (security_trading_snapshot.total_trading_val, O_PTTT_44). Chỉ lọc market_id_code (SQL BA Nhóm 11 không có board).
etl_logic: SUM(securities_trade.execution_val) FROM securities_trade LEFT JOIN (SELECT security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol, security_trading_snapshot.isin_code, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt ORDER BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_time DESC, security_trading_snapshot.sequence DESC) AS rn FROM security_trading_snapshot WHERE security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt = :etl_date) sts ON sts.rn = 1 AND sts.trading_dt = securities_trade.trade_dt AND ((securities_trade.src_stm_code = 'ORDERTRADE_TRADE_BOOK_HOSE' AND sts.symbol = securities_trade.security_symbol_code) OR (securities_trade.src_stm_code = 'ORDERTRADE_TRADE_BOOK_HNX' AND sts.isin_code = securities_trade.security_symbol_code)) WHERE securities_trade.trade_dt = :etl_date AND securities_trade.market_id_code IN ('STO','STX','UPX') GROUP BY COALESCE(sts.symbol, securities_trade.security_symbol_code), CASE WHEN securities_trade.execution_val >= 1000000000 THEN 'GTGD >= 1 ty' ELSE 'GTGD < 1 ty' END, securities_trade.trade_dt

description: Phân loại quy mô lệnh (GTGD >= 1 tỷ / GTGD < 1 tỷ) [SỬA 2026-10-14 — issue QA, O_PTTT_49] Phân loại TỪNG giao dịch khớp theo execution_val (mỗi bản ghi securities_trade = 1 lệnh khớp), không phân theo tổng GTGD cả ngày của mã.
etl_logic: CASE WHEN securities_trade.execution_val >= 1000000000 THEN 'GTGD >= 1 ty' ELSE 'GTGD < 1 ty' END (phân loại từng giao dịch khớp: mỗi bản ghi securities_trade = 1 lệnh khớp, GTGD = execution_val) FROM securities_trade WHERE securities_trade.trade_dt = :etl_date AND securities_trade.market_id_code IN ('STO','STX','UPX')

description: KL khớp lệnh theo mã CK × nhóm quy mô lệnh × ngày [SỬA 2026-10-14 — issue QA, O_PTTT_49] Σ KL của TỪNG giao dịch khớp thuộc band (securities_trade.execution_vol), thay cho security_trading_snapshot.total_trading_vol cả ngày (O_PTTT_44). Chỉ lọc market_id_code (BA dòng 239).
etl_logic: SUM(securities_trade.execution_vol) FROM securities_trade LEFT JOIN (SELECT security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol, security_trading_snapshot.isin_code, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt ORDER BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_time DESC, security_trading_snapshot.sequence DESC) AS rn FROM security_trading_snapshot WHERE security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt = :etl_date) sts ON sts.rn = 1 AND sts.trading_dt = securities_trade.trade_dt AND ((securities_trade.src_stm_code = 'ORDERTRADE_TRADE_BOOK_HOSE' AND sts.symbol = securities_trade.security_symbol_code) OR (securities_trade.src_stm_code = 'ORDERTRADE_TRADE_BOOK_HNX' AND sts.isin_code = securities_trade.security_symbol_code)) WHERE securities_trade.trade_dt = :etl_date AND securities_trade.market_id_code IN ('STO','STX','UPX') GROUP BY COALESCE(sts.symbol, securities_trade.security_symbol_code), CASE WHEN securities_trade.execution_val >= 1000000000 THEN 'GTGD >= 1 ty' ELSE 'GTGD < 1 ty' END, securities_trade.trade_dt
